bone_edge._doc: E4 (the A1 day-1 ruling): the WAR share under which a new game's Bone Mill makes no bone, FLOOD held at opening.valve's and WORK the rest: the pits have first call on the bodies and, below it, eat every one (a growth feedback over minutes, no closed form). Measured from cmd_new_game (tools' edge probe); test_day1_queues brackets it. The start valve keeps WAR above it. view_hud.bone_war_share shows it for the valve readout; a new game's edge, not a later state's.

relic_trickle._doc: E4 step 9, the run's manager's rulings on step 9 (3) (2026-11-17 12:45 and 14:24; MECHANICS 2, the relics row): one relic per period_s of game time while no raidable fort remains, read as every fort at or below the highest tier ever flipped being held (GameState.relic_trickle_paying), paid into the relic store (lost at its cap). For a player walled at a tier. Read REQUIRED by GameState.

upkeep._doc: resume_net_min (gold/s; E4 step 4, the manager's ruling on the gold-trap stop): an unpaid building resumes only while the gold income exceeds the paying upkeep plus its own by more than this (0: strictly positive), besides its stocks covering one hold. A town whose income can't pay every building keeps the rest unpaid and saves the surplus. One margin (7e5602c, TownSim.income_pays): the income beats a bill by more than resume_net_min + NET_EPS (1e-9), read from state; the resume rule, held_by_income and the queue's upkeep gate all judge by it, so a tie is refused by all three at any step size.

starved_lever._doc: E4 (the A1 day-1 ruling): the lever per TownSim.mill_starved reason, on view_town's mill rows and a queue head short of bone. pits_first: the pits ate the bodies the mill wanted; more WAR makes more corpses at the forts. E4 step 10 (review-t7r1r2 §5): the lever per TownSim.trade_starved reason, on a queue row short of gold and not of bone. living_first: the living buy less than the staffed stalls can sell, so a Market level sells nothing more; more housing (the cap) or an Inn (its cap and attract) raises the living.

husk._doc: GUESS (E4 step 2's sizing, lever (b)): cmd_craft_husk grinds this many remnants (the weakest) and this much bone into a t1 husk (loot.json chest_by_tier 1's husk_kinds). Slow and costly by its price: the bone competes with the build queue. Re-priced so the bone binds and the remnants stay a light raid-side gate (vision review E4 M1 item 6; the run's manager, 2026-11-17): 500 bone is 91% of a full early store (sessions sits at its 550 cap through day 7, so ~600 would never be payable). Sessions reaches Vei-ready on day 6.0001 at the band's edge, with 12 crafts (BALANCE §5).

foreman._doc: E3-3, v0 values: E4 placeholders (BALANCE §5). A big undead placed town:<lot_id> works there only at a building with job slots that is active (built, paid, not upgrading, not idled by Thrift, with hands staffed): it multiplies the building's job output by mult + speed x speed_k (MECHANICS §4.2) and adds presence_k x presence to the morale target.
